## Objective
Add an evidence-backed operating-net layer that separates strategy net, venue friction, funding, and fixed operating costs using real venue observations.

## Owning authority
- V8_Profesyonel_Benchmark_Arastirmasi.pdf, accounting and cost sections.
- D-116 monetary accounting.
- docs/issues/ISSUE_KZ012_COST001_AUTHORITATIVE_VENUE_COST_FEASIBILITY.md
- Related TCA issue #268 and cost issue #219.

## Change class
CONTRACT_IMPLEMENTATION

## Current state
v8-next accepts configured maker/taker fee assumptions and displays monthly OPEX in a limitation note, but does not compute a verified business-net metric. Actual fee tier, fill-vs-mid spread/slippage distribution, funding finality, server/model/API costs, and cost calibration are not bound to the benchmark receipt.

## Required end state
R1 — Produce separate transaction P&L, funding/carry, explicit fees, strategy net, and operating net.
R2 — Calibrate fee and slippage assumptions from physical venue receipts; never reuse spread/slippage twice.
R3 — Bind OPEX period, currency, allocation rule, and source artifacts to the run.
R4 — Report business-net uncertainty and fail closed when any component is unmeasurable.

## Expected file / module surface
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/economic_benchmark.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/costs.py (new)
v8-next/src/v8_next/evaluation/report.py
v8-next/src/v8_next/adapters/shadow_ingest.py
v8-next/tests/test_report_accounting.py
v8-next/tests/test_operating_net.py (new)

## Verification gates
Test component conservation, maker/taker tier selection, fill-vs-mid calibration, funding inclusion, fixed-cost period allocation, currency/unit checks, double-count prevention, and missing-source refusal. Reproduce on a physical venue capture.

## Required evidence artifacts
Venue fee schedule and receipt manifest; fill-vs-mid distribution; funding ledger; OPEX manifest/invoice inputs; strategy-net and operating-net reconciliation; versioned cost receipt.

## Non-goals / forbidden scope
No fabricated cost constants, no linear cost scaling presented as venue truth, no business profitability claim, no cost double counting, no live-money activation.

### Context-completeness contract

### 11. Normative Traceability
R1 — Fees are explicit and not deducted twice. Authority: PDF accounting table.
R2 — Spread/slippage embedded in price is not separately subtracted without an identified component.
R3 — Operating net is distinct from strategy net and requires actual period costs.

### 12. Existing Types / Interfaces to Reuse
Reuse MetricSet, cost_basis, funding fields, ArtifactBinding, shadow fill/account records, and existing MISSING/UNVERIFIED statuses.

### 13. Mathematical / Semantic Invariants
I1: operating_net = strategy_net - explicitly allocated operating_costs, with currency/period identity.
I2: total cashflow reconciles to venue/account records.
I3: unavailable components remain None/MISSING, never zero.

### 14. Canonical Failure Semantics
Missing fee/funding/OPEX evidence -> MISSING or EXECUTION_UNPROVEN.
Double-count detected -> BLOCKED.
Nonfinite/unit mismatch -> INVALID.
Uncertified positive net -> NO_ECONOMIC_CLAIM.

### 15. Dependency Map
venue/cost artifacts -> component calibration -> strategy net -> operating net -> economic receipt/report.

### 16. Ambiguity / OPEN_PIN Triggers
- If an owning contract or estimand is ambiguous, STOP and open an OPEN_PIN.
- If an artifact cannot be physically produced and hashed, STOP; do not substitute it.
- If the requested behavior would open protected OOS or mint authority, STOP pending explicit governance.

### References / sources / attachments
Related: #219, #268, #364, #368. Current economic benchmark only displays OPEX separately and marks funding missing.

### V8 guards
- [x] I will not invent a new canonical error code, ontology, or parallel interface unless an R# requirement explicitly authorizes it.
- [x] No unrelated semantic strategy change is bundled into this implementation issue.
- [x] No frozen OOS is opened unless this issue explicitly carries that authority.
- [x] If the owning contract is ambiguous, I will open/escalate an OPEN_PIN rather than invent an interpretation.
